inv.desc_en:
COMMERCIAL PREMISES FOR SALE IN MIRAFLORES
Opportunity in Miraflores, premises with an approximate area of 32 m², consisting of two adjoining units.
The property has previously been used as a storage room and storage space, offering multiple possibilities for use and adaptation according to the buyer's needs.
Due to its dimensions and layout, it is ideal as a warehouse, large-capacity storage room, archive, small workshop, or auxiliary space for professionals and freelancers, with other uses potentially being studied depending on applicable regulations.
Located in an established area of Miraflores, with easy access and good transport links.
Main features:
Approximate area: 32 m²
Two joined units
Previously used as a storage room/warehouse
Open-plan and usable space
Ideal as an investment or auxiliary space
Miraflores area, Malaga. An excellent opportunity for anyone looking for a versatile and functional space in Malaga.
Contact us for more information or to arrange a visit.
